messages:
alex: quick check — before we promote the staging config set to prod, can we run the new preflight validators and surface a compact diff in the console?

mira: absolutely. which validators are you thinking? schema + perf regressions + quota-impact?

alex: yeah: 1) schema + type checks, 2) sample request replay w/ latency delta, 3) quota/cost estimator, 4) telemetry sampling sanity (no metric drops). small output we can show as a preview.

jen: love the preview idea. UX suggestion: show a small "preview run" timeline with pass/warn/fail states and a one-line summary. click to expand for logs. :eyes:

sam: +1. for replay we should run against a tiny fixed cohort (<=100 requests) and surface p95/p99 deltas. also add a safety threshold config e.g. `{\n  "max_p99_increase_pct": "15",\n  "max_error_increase_pct": "3"\n}`

alex: makes sense. for API, propose adding `validation_level` to the config promote API with values `strict|warn|off`. default `warn`.

mira: hmm, need to be careful: `strict` should block promotion if any validator fails. `warn` should allow but require an explicit checkbox in console. `off` skips preflight.

jen: console UX: when `warn` and there's a failure, show a conspicuous banner: "Warnings detected — promotion allowed with acknowledgment" and a required typed-confirmation.

sam: ops implications: we need an automated rollback plan when promotion causes SLO regression. propose a small guard: monitor SLOs for 15m post-promotion; if p95 latency increases > 20% or error rate > 1% absolute, auto-roll back.

mira: can we reuse the existing incident-alerting hooks? ops-bot could create a provisional incident and mark the change as suspect.

ops-bot: [automated] will create incident if auto-rollback criteria met. example alert payload: `{ "trigger": "p95_delta>20pct", "window": "15m", "action": "rollback" }`

alex: perfect. one more: we should store the preflight outputs as attachments on the change record (json blob + short human summary) so audit + postmortem are easier.

jen: Agreed. Also add a small telemetry gating option: if telemetry ingestion drops by >30% in the 15m window, block promotion immediately. that catches misconfig that disable stats.

sam: technical note — replay must be idempotent-safe. use synthetic user cohort and avoid hitting billing endpoints. add `--dry-run` flag in the CLI that rewrites any outbound billable calls to noop.

alex: example CLI: `redwood config promote --env=prod --validation_level=strict --dry-run=false`

mira: API shape suggestion for promote endpoint: `{ "config_id": "c-123", "validation_level": "strict", "preview": true }` where `preview=true` runs validators but does not flip the config.

sam: minor: preview should also run quota estimator and show expected spend delta as a single line: e.g. `+12% tokens` / `~$0.03 per 1k requests`.

jen: ok actionable items:
- alex: add `validation_level` param to promote API + CLI (PR)
- mira: wire in preflight validators + incident hook (work with ops)
- sam: implement replay cohort + dry-run safety + cost estimator
- jen: mockups for preview UX + typed-confirmation pattern

alex: timeline? aiming for small alpha this week, wider test early next week.

mira: I'll scope validators today, pinging @sam for replay infra details.

sam: tagging a follow-up thread for replay infra decisions.

jen: I'll drop a Figma link in the morning.

alex: thanks everyone :thumbsup:

ops-bot: [reminder] make sure audit logs retention for staging changes is >=90d per compliance.

mira: noted. I'll update the runbook with rollback thresholds and who to page on auto-rollback.

sam: quick Q — do we want to gate promotions by feature-flag ownership approval? maybe require owner ack for `warn` promotions.

jen: yes, require owner ack for `warn`. the console preview should show owner and provide "Request approval" button.

alex: final: I'll open the API/CLI PR and link here when ready.

sam: cool, will review.

jen: thanks all!
